sources: Freedom to Proselytize (5-star Arts Unit). Nothing here acts on damage dealt, so this kit declares nothing. Skill 3, sk_wpn_funnel_0012 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData; values from SkillPatchTable at the weapon's skill-3 level): "Main Attribute +{all_attr_up}. When the wielder's battle skill provides HP treatment, the controlled operator is restored for another [{hp_will_add} + Will×{hp_will_mult}] HP. Effect only triggers once every {cd}s." The Main Attribute % (cardAttributeModifier formulaItem 6, modifyAttributeType 1) and skills 1-2 (wpn_attr_will_mid: Will, wpn_sp_attr_heal_mid: Treatment Efficiency) are in the stat panel.

The extra heal: passiveEventActions abilityEvent 50 (the wielder heals) → CheckHealTag -320297214 (battle-skill heals), CheckHp (isRatio, compare 0: below 0.99) on the controlled operator (CharacterTeamFinder + MainCharacterValidator), CheckGlobalCDTimerAction (cd 15 s) → HealAction (MultiplyAttributeCalculation attribute 42 Will × hp_will_mult + hp_will_add) on the controlled operator, AddGlobalCDTimer. Operator HP isn't simulated (N2, deferred: operators count as topped up), so the controlled operator is never below 99% and the extra heal never happens; with HP it would be a trigger on {event: heal, kinds: [battle]}, by: self, cooldown cd → heal controlled. buff_wpn_funnel_0012 (formulaItem 6 main attribute) is never created: toggleBuffs names buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01, which has no BuffData file. Docs: docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0011_seraph.md (E1-E2).
